item.name: Fetch active Medical Malpractice policy document

query.description: (Required) Type of policy customer has bought. For Medical Malpractice it should be mmp.
(Required) policy-id received in /load-policies API response.
(Required) policy-no received in /load-policies API response.
Language of policy document, either English (en) or Arabic (ar). Default is en, for Arabic, query parameter ar must be passed.
Policy document format. If provided then it should be base64. If not provided then policy document as PDF will be returned.
